must_say: say where it hurts — slot: the part of the body
say when it started — slot: the time expression
say how strong it is — slot: the number or word
answer whether you have a symptom — slot: the symptom
ask what the problem is — slot: none
ask whether you need a test — slot: the test
ask how often to take something — slot: the medicine
confirm you understand the instruction — slot: none
must_understand: asks where it hurts, since when, and how bad it is
asks whether you have other symptoms
says what the problem is or what they think it is
explains whether you need a test or medicine
gives instructions for treatment and when to come back
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is at a medical consultation with a doctor in a clinic. This is the main interaction where the health problem is described, the doctor asks basic questions, and the learner needs to understand the likely problem and the treatment plan.
Learner: Patient. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: booking the appointment, reception questions, payment, buying medicine at a pharmacy.
